title: Vision Exam Copay Leaderboard
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vision:exam copay_usd=*
| stats sum(copay_usd) as total_value, avg(copay_usd) as avg_value by provider_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks provider values by total and average copay across vision exam events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `copay_usd` values for each vision exam event and review total and average copay by provider.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total copay.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which provider shows the biggest copay numbers in your vision exam data.
